name: Deep Elem Mine
summary: In central Silverpine Forest, worgen hold Deep Elem Mine and its tunnels. Once worked for ore, the mine fell when Archmage Arugal's magic swept through the region and changed its miners.

sections.title: A Den of Beasts
sections.body: Deep Elem Mine once supplied ore to the living people of Lordaeron. Then Archmage Arugal unleashed his lupine curse across Silverpine Forest, and it spread through the tunnels. The laborers succumbed and became vicious worgen. They left their pickaxes behind and claimed the cavern as a lair.

sections.title: Grimson and Forsaken Ambition
sections.body: Grimson the Pale commands the pack inside Deep Elem Mine. Once the mine's foreman, he kept his cunning through the change. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek to reclaim the tunnels and their ore. On orders backed by Dreadlord Varimathras, their agents mean to sever Grimson's head and purge the beasts, so the Horde can secure the mine's wealth.

faq.q: What is inside Deep Elem Mine?
aliases: who lives in deep elem mine
faq.answer: Hostile worgen afflicted by Archmage Arugal's magic fill Deep Elem Mine. Grimson the Pale, once the human foreman, leads the pack deep in the tunnels.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Deep Elem Mine cleared?
faq.answer: The Forsaken want the mine's mineral wealth for their war efforts in Lordaeron. Dalar Dawnweaver and the Sepulcher's leaders mean to claim its resources in the name of Dreadlord Varimathras once the worgen are gone.

Grimson the Pale was Deep Elem Mine's mortal foreman. Arugal's feral curse transformed the workers, and Grimson became a cunning worgen alpha. He kept enough of his intellect to command the pack in the mine.

faq.q: How did the worgen get into the mine?
aliases: why are there worgen in the mine
faq.answer: Deep Elem Mine's worgen began as its own laborers. Archmage Arugal's curse spread across Silverpine Forest and changed them where they worked.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, securing the mine brings economic gain and fulfills the Sepulcher's order to break Arugal's grip on central Silverpine.
The feral pack makes mining dangerous, but Deep Elem Mine holds one of Silverpine's richest underground mineral deposits.
